messages:
Nina: quick sync to decide scope for SOC2 evidence packaging + retention lanes. sales needs concrete SLAs for enterprise offers.
Omar: hi all. main asks from customers: signed export bundles, tenant-level legal hold, and BYOK-compatible archives.
Priya: sketch of milestones: M1 = evidence package export (signed manifest + event bundle) + 30d searchable window; M2 = legal-hold snapshot + immutable chain-of-custody; M3 = BYOK archival support + key rotation API.
Ben: cost signal: keeping 3yr warm index is expensive. need pricing lanes (standard=30d, compliance=3yr, enterprise=7yr) and per-GB export credits.
Nina: acceptance criteria for M1: export includes manifest.json with SHA256 digests, export signed by our code-sig key, export time SLA < 24h for up to 500k events. search p95 < 1.5s on 30d window.
Omar: infra note: export generation currently serializes events; can parallelize by shard to hit SLA but need one infra hire to tune. paging infra for estimate.
Priya: legal: LegalBot, can phased delivery (M1 then M2) be contract-safe if we include migration/export guarantees?
LegalBot: legal: phased delivery acceptable provided contract addendum specifies capabilities per milestone, emergency export SLA (24h) and escrow workflow if customer requires. must log all key escrow accesses and produce signed audit trail.
Ben: billing-bot: we should surface retention tier as a checkbox during provisioning with clear surcharge. billing-bot: proposed lanes: standard: $0.02/GB-mo (30d), compliance: $0.10/GB-mo (3yr, partial index), enterprise: $0.25/GB-mo (7yr, full index). export credits: $5 per 100k events.
Nina: BYOK note: for M3 we accept wrapped keys only, store ciphertext. escrow option requires HSM escrow and a formal access workflow. rotation API must support rolling key wrap with zero-downtime rewrap.
Omar: security: rewraps on archived blobs are expensive; propose storing per-archive KEK identifiers and lazy rewrap on access. document that in acceptance.
Priya: product decision ask: greenlight M1 (evidence export + 30d search) for Q2, document retention tiers and pricing, and resource ask for 1 infra contractor to optimize export job. BYOK pilot for 1 customer in Q2 if PO received, GA in Q3. thumbs?
Ben: :thumbsup: pricing looks reasonable but reserve final numbers for finance review.
Omar: +1 for M1 and infra hire.
Nina: +1 on pilot conditional on PO. I'll draft SLA language and sample contract addendum.
LegalBot: legal: I'll provide escrow/access clause template and requirements for signed manifests.
billing-bot: billing: created pricing draft PR #452 and attached to epic.
Priya: follow-ups: Nina -> SLA + addendum; Omar -> infra cost + hiring ticket; Ben -> finance signoff on pricing; Priya -> create epic and customer comms.
Nina: will sync with sales for messaging. thanks team.
